name: Age Difference
overview: The Scriptures remind us that God is the Creator of all things, establishing the foundation for human relationships across all ages. While the sample verses do not directly address age differences in relationships, the call to trust in God's sovereign plan and love, exemplified through Christ's sacrifice, encourages believers to approach dating and marriage with wisdom and grace. The empowerment of the Holy Spirit equips Christians to navigate relational challenges faithfully, ensuring that age difference is not a barrier to honoring God in all relationships.
